newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans seen steady to two cents lower.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans seen steady to two cents lower.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures were expected to open steady to two cents per bushel lower Wednesday as the market follows overnight trends, traders said.
On Project A overnight trade, soybeans closed down 2-3/4 to 1-1/4 cents per bushel.
Trading on Wednesday is expected to be subdued in front of the U.S. Department of Agriculture's acreage report on Monday as well as the Good Friday holiday on Friday.
Concerns about the pace of exports from Brazil lessened Wednesday. Damage to a grain-loading conveyor belt at Paranagua port was expected to be repaired by April 2.
